name: Yasaka Aroe
source:
A young girl who has been left alone in a city that collapsed. She has trouble communicating with others due to having autism.

While she is quiet, there will be situations where she will show sudden and unpredictable behavior, and bother people by repeating difficult to understand words. On the other hand, she has a few mysterious abilities that normal people don't have.
